blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified nonproxy SavingsReUSD and its ERC-20/ERC-4626 source contain no direct holder blacklist, transfer pause, seizure or arbitrary-holder burn. Native ERC-4626 withdrawals burn the holder's shares under ordinary allowance rules. Core ownership and reward/bridge configuration are separate control powers, not proof of a native freeze. Freeze exposure remains inherited from reusd-resupply and its backing dependencies.

oracleRisk.summary: sreUSD values local shares from onchain REUSD custody and vested-reward accounting. It has no local collateral-liquidation engine or external market-price oracle; parent price and upstream mechanism risk remain inherited.

branchApplicability.rationale: The ERC-4626 share-to-underlying exchange rate is the top-level mint/redemption authority. There are no borrower-owned collateral branches on the savings token.
